source_recipes.1: i=0 positive unity impulse, other samples positive zero
source_recipes.2: i=1023 negative three-quarter impulse, other samples positive zero
source_recipes.3: 1024 positive zero; prior block history remains
source_recipes.7: R32(R64(R64(1e-24)*R64((i%7)-3))), integer i=0..1023; decimal 1e-24 first rounds to binary64

input_construction: Construct base from source_recipe_id; multiply by exact row_scale_rational, separately round binary32. A reset generates complete state and six programme maxima from the stated input rule; otherwise continue each implementation actual state. expected is never a state seed.
serialization: F32LE, rows then sample/state index; expected state hex is exactly six*4628*4 bytes encoded as lowercase ASCII hex, no headers

input.reset_rule: all positive zero except LFE word i=R32(((i%7)-3)/32)
